de: Parking places for large families will be placed near schools, kindergartens, clinics, airports and railway stations. This was reported in the Ministry of transport of the Russian Federation on November 3.

de: The Russian Armed Forces struck the Novaya Poshta logistics center in Berdichev, where they stored and distributed cargoes for the Ukrainian Armed Forces supplied by Western countries. This was reported in the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation on November 3.

de: Spending on the midterm elections to the U.S. Congress could reach a record 11.9 billion dollars, which is about a third more than four years ago.

de: Russian President Vladimir Putin submitted for ratification to the State Duma an agreement with Cambodia on the transfer of persons sentenced to imprisonment. The document was published in the electronic database of the chamber on November 3.

de: With the abolition of the self-employment regime, a significant part of the self-employed will return to the shadows, and all goals for legalization will have to start from scratch. d: Для защиты своего оборудования российским ритейлерам стоит провести инвентаризацию, проверить доступ из интернета и ограничить удаленный доступ. Об этом рассказал эксперт по IT-безопасности Виталий Камалов в интервью MIR24.TV.
te: The expert told how Russian retailers to protect refrigerators from cyber attacks
de: To protect their equipment, Russian retailers should conduct an inventory, check access from the Internet and limit remote access. This was told by IT security expert Vitaly Kamalov in an interview with MIR24.TV.

te: When assigning a single allowance will begin to take into account the turnover on bank accounts
de: The Ministry of Labor has developed a draft decree of the Government of the Russian Federation, which proposes to start taking into account from April 1, 2027, when assigning a single allowance for children, not only family income, but also turnover on its bank accounts.

t: ФАС предложила повысить тарифы «Почты России» на 8,1 процента
d: Федеральная антимонопольная служба (ФАС) подготовила проект приказа ведомства, предлагающий увеличить в среднем на 8,1 процента предельные тарифы на регулируемые услуги «Почты России» с 2027 года.
te: FAS has proposed to increase tariffs “Mail of Russia” by 8.1 percent
de: The Federal Antimonopoly Service (FAS) has prepared a draft order of the department, which proposes to increase by an average of 8.1 percent the marginal tariffs for regulated services of the Russian Post from 2027.

t: Операторы связи перестанут брать плату за часть СМС от «Почты России»
d: С 1 марта 2027 года сотовые операторы будут бесплатно передавать часть технических СМС от «Почты России». Речь идет об уведомлениях, необходимых для использования почтовых сервисов. Постановление кабмина утвердили в рамках мер поддержки…
te: Telecom operators will cease to charge for part of SMS from the “Mail of Russia”
de: From March 1, 2027, mobile operators will transfer a part of technical SMS from the Russian Post free of charge. These are the notifications required for the use of postal services. The decree of the Cabinet approved in the framework of support measures…

t: В Росгвардии планируют обновить гардероб
d: В Росгвардии решили усовершенствовать гардероб военнослужащих. Соответствующий проект указа размещен для общественного обсуждения на федеральном портале проектов нормативных правовых актов.
te: In Regardie plan to update the wardrobe
de: In Regardie decided to improve the wardrobe of military personnel. The corresponding draft decree is posted for public discussion on the federal portal of draft normative legal acts.
